chorus.voices: How many detuned copies run beside the dry chain; 0 is neutral, and each voice is one more pass at every step.
chorus.sigma: The detune: each voice's noise at the layer, as a share of the stream's size there (its root mean square).
chorus.layer: The one layer whose stream the voices add their noise to, 0 (the embedding) to 12.

tap.layer: The layer whose stream is read through the final norm and the output layer: 12 is the model's own output, 0 the embedding.

meter.layer: The layer whose stream's size (its L2 norm) is shown at each token: 0 is the embedding, 12 the last block's output.

gauge.dir: The direction to measure along, made unit length at the layer read; negation ships with the Lens.
gauge.layer: The layer whose stream is measured against the direction.

scope.head: The head to watch, as block.head counted from 0: 4.11 is block 4's last head.
